'''The Last Spell (Part 2)''' (Japanese: '''最後のおまじない (後編)''' ''The Final Good-Luck Charm (Part 2)'') is the sixty-eighth chapter of the [[Magical Pokémon Journey]] manga.

==Plot==
{{incomplete plot}}
{{spoilers}}
[[Almond]] pursues [[Hazel]], who's lost in {{p|Mew}}'s Forest. {{p|Mewtwo}} cannot stand humans, who have caused him nothing but pain and sorrow. Will Hazel find Mew? Will her heart's greatest wish finally be granted?
